# sensory result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sensoryResult`](gmeow-sensoryResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sensoryResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The scalar quantity result of a sensory observation — a value with unit, determinacy, and granularity. Subproperty of [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) so generic consumers can query all observation results without knowing the domain. The reference frame in which the quantity is expressed is carried on the observation via [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) and propagates to the result via the existing [`isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md) ∘ [`hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) chain.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) -> [`gmeow:SensoryQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryQuantity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)

Use [`gmeow:sensoryResult`](gmeow-sensoryResult.md) from [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) to [`gmeow:SensoryQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryQuantity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Sensor Reading

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/sensory/examples/sensor-reading.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/sensory/examples/sensor-reading.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-sensory-examples-sensor-reading)#example-slices-extensions-sensory-examples-sensor-reading

```turtle
# --- The reading: what, which property, the result, the sensor as vantage, and
#     the method (a SensoryObservation is a core Observation — it records its
#     gmeow:observationMethod like any other).
ex:obs a gmeow:SensoryObservation ;
    gmeow:sensoryObservationOf ex:greenhouse ;
    gmeow:sensoryProperty      ex:humidity ;
    gmeow:sensoryResult        ex:quantity ;
    gmeow:vantage              ex:dht22 ;
    gmeow:observationMethod    gmeow:methodInstrumentalReading .
```
